data.name: Personal Design
data.description: You increase the maximum number of psionic tattoos you can have on your body to thirty.  In addition, you automatically identify any visible psionic tattoos on other creatures.  Finally, as an immediate action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, you can activeate any psionic tattoo on your body.
